days.title: Central Rivers and Information
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Oulankajoki
stops.detail: The river Oulankajoki – with its tributaries Savinajoki and Aventojoki the main attraction of the landscape – flows through the park in a west-east direction.

stops.name: Oulanka Visitors Centre
stops.detail: There are two information points – the Oulanka Visitors Centre near the rapids of the Oulankajoki in the center of the park and the Karhunkierros Visitor Centre with display boards and information about the plants and animals in the park (Karhu is the Finnish word for brown bear).
